## TL;DR

- 161 valid regions appear in the test role exactly once across 10 folds.
- The deterministic refinement accepted 15 constrained swaps.
- It reduced the mobility objective by 40.6%, while all targets retained at least 80.7% of incoming mobility context.
- Case burden is well balanced. Deaths, wastewater, and absolute population load remain less uniform because Barcelona is indivisible.

    for candidate in (start, *start.parents):

    raise FileNotFoundError("Could not find the EpiForecaster project root")

## Objective and constraints

\[
\mathcal{L} = f_{\mathrm{internal}}
+ 0.25 f_{\mathrm{high-flow}}
+ 0.50 f_{\mathrm{worst-fold}}
+ 10\,\mathrm{mean}_i\left[\max(0, 0.75-r_i)^2\right]
\]

| Term | Meaning |
|---|---|
| \(f_{\mathrm{internal}}\) | All mean mobility flow unavailable inside test folds |
| \(f_{\mathrm{high-flow}}\) | Internal mass for flows at or above the 99.5th percentile |
| \(f_{\mathrm{worst-fold}}\) | Largest single-fold internal-flow fraction |
| \(r_i\) | Incoming mobility context retained for target region \(i\) |

Hard constraints: every target must retain at least 70% incoming context; every balancing feature must remain within the original representative-split envelope.

```{python}
#| label: objective-plots
#| fig-cap: "Retention penalty and the observed objective decomposition during deterministic refinement."
#| out-width: "100%"
#| fig-width: 13
#| fig-height: 5
retention = np.linspace(0.40, 1.00, 400)
penalty = 10.0 * np.maximum(0.0, 0.75 - retention) ** 2

objective_terms = history.assign(
    internal=history["total_test_internal_flow_fraction"],
    high_flow=0.25 * history["high_flow_event_internal_fraction"],
    worst_fold=0.50 * history["worst_fold_internal_flow_fraction"],
)
objective_terms["retention_shortfall"] = (
    objective_terms["objective_score"]
    - objective_terms[["internal", "high_flow", "worst_fold"]].sum(axis=1)
).clip(lower=0.0)

figure, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(13, 5), constrained_layout=True)

axes[0].plot(retention * 100, penalty, color=PURPLE, linewidth=2.8)
axes[0].axvline(70, color=INK, linestyle="--", linewidth=1.4, label="Hard floor")
axes[0].axvline(75, color=ORANGE, linestyle=":", linewidth=2.0, label="Ideal floor")
axes[0].set(
    title="Retention-shortfall penalty",
    xlabel="Incoming mobility context retained (%)",
    ylabel="Objective contribution",
    xlim=(40, 100),
)
axes[0].legend(frameon=False)

term_columns = ["internal", "high_flow", "worst_fold", "retention_shortfall"]
term_labels = ["Internal flow", "High-flow penalty", "Worst-fold penalty", "Retention shortfall"]
term_colors = [BLUE, ORANGE, TEAL, PURPLE]
axes[1].stackplot(
    objective_terms["iteration"],
    *(objective_terms[column] for column in term_columns),
    labels=term_labels,
    colors=term_colors,
    alpha=0.88,
)
axes[1].plot(
    objective_terms["iteration"],
    objective_terms["objective_score"],
    color=INK,
    linewidth=2.2,
    marker="o",
    markersize=3,
    label="Total objective",
)
axes[1].set(
    title="Objective terms across accepted swaps",
    xlabel="Accepted constrained swap",
    ylabel="Objective value",
)
axes[1].legend(frameon=False, fontsize=8, loc="upper right")

for axis in axes:
    axis.grid(axis="y", color=GRID, alpha=0.8)
    axis.spines[["top", "right"]].set_visible(False)
```

```{python}
#| label: objective-receipt
#| echo: false
initial = history.iloc[0]
final = history.iloc[-1]
objective_change = 100 * (final.objective_score / initial.objective_score - 1)

pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "quantity": [
            "accepted swaps",
            "objective",
            "worst target retained flow",
            "worst-fold internal flow",
            "high-flow internal fraction",
        ],
        "initial": [
            0,
            initial.objective_score,
            initial.minimum_target_retained_flow,
            initial.worst_fold_internal_flow_fraction,
            initial.high_flow_event_internal_fraction,
        ],
        "refined": [
            int(final.iteration),
            final.objective_score,
            final.minimum_target_retained_flow,
            final.worst_fold_internal_flow_fraction,
            final.high_flow_event_internal_fraction,
        ],
    }
).assign(
    change=lambda frame: [
        "15",
        f"{objective_change:.1f}%",
        f"{100 * (final.minimum_target_retained_flow - initial.minimum_target_retained_flow):+.1f} pp",
        f"{100 * (final.worst_fold_internal_flow_fraction - initial.worst_fold_internal_flow_fraction):+.1f} pp",
        f"{100 * (final.high_flow_event_internal_fraction - initial.high_flow_event_internal_fraction):+.1f} pp",
    ]
)
```

## Mobility split quality

```{python}
#| label: mobility-quality
#| fig-cap: "Coverage and retained mobility context for the baseline and refined representative splits."
#| out-width: "100%"
#| fig-width: 13
#| fig-height: 5
selected = strategy_summary[
    strategy_summary["strategy"].isin(
        ["Independent stratified seeds", "Representative 10-fold", "Refined representative 10-fold"]
    )
].copy()
selected["short_name"] = ["Independent\nseeds", "Representative\n10-fold", "Refined\n10-fold"]
colors = [BLUE, ORANGE, TEAL]
positions = np.arange(len(selected))

figure, axes = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(13, 5), constrained_layout=True)

axes[0].bar(positions, 100 * selected["test_region_coverage"], color=colors)
for position, (_, row) in enumerate(selected.iterrows()):
    axes[0].text(
        position,
        100 * row.test_region_coverage + 2,
        f"{int(row.unique_test_regions)}/{int(row.valid_region_count)}",
        ha="center",
        fontweight="semibold",
    )
axes[0].set(
    title="Exactly-once test coverage",
    ylabel="Valid target regions covered (%)",
    ylim=(0, 110),
)
axes[0].set_xticks(positions, labels=selected["short_name"])

for column, marker, label in (
    ("mean_incoming_flow_retained", "o", "Mean target"),
    ("worst_target_incoming_flow_retained", "D", "Worst target"),
):
    axes[1].plot(
        positions,
        100 * selected[column],
        color=INK,
        marker=marker,
        linewidth=1.6,
        label=label,
    )
axes[1].axhline(70, color=INK, linestyle="--", linewidth=1.2, label="Hard floor")
axes[1].axhline(75, color=ORANGE, linestyle=":", linewidth=1.8, label="Ideal floor")
axes[1].set(
    title="Incoming mobility context retained",
    ylabel="Retained flow (%)",
    ylim=(0, 105),
)
axes[1].set_xticks(positions, labels=selected["short_name"])
axes[1].legend(frameon=False, fontsize=8, loc="lower left")

for column, marker, label in (
    ("mean_test_internal_flow_fraction", "o", "Mean test-fold flow"),
    ("mean_high_flow_event_internal_fraction", "D", "High-flow events"),
):
    axes[2].plot(
        positions,
        100 * selected[column],
        color=INK,
        marker=marker,
        linewidth=1.6,
        label=label,
    )
axes[2].set(
    title="Mobility isolated inside test folds",
    ylabel="Complete-network flow (%)",
    ylim=(0, 1.3),
)
axes[2].set_xticks(positions, labels=selected["short_name"])
axes[2].legend(frameon=False, fontsize=8)

for axis in axes:
    axis.grid(axis="y", color=GRID, alpha=0.8)
    axis.spines[["top", "right"]].set_visible(False)
```
